article.headline: Javan Simmons scores 17, Toledo beats Central Michigan 69-67
article.description: — Javan Simmons scored 17 points on Friday night to help Toledo beat the Central Michigan Chippewas 69-67 for the Rockets' third win in a row.
article.linkText: Javan Simmons scores 17, Toledo beats Central Michigan 69-67
article.story: TOLEDO, Ohio -- — Javan Simmons scored 17 points on Friday night to help Toledo beat the Central Michigan Chippewas 69-67 for the Rockets' third win in a row. Simmons made 5 of 9 from the field and 7 of 10 from the free-throw line for Toledo (9-6, 3-0 Mid-American Conference). Sam Lewis added 15 points, Sonny Wilson scored 11 and Bryce Ford 10. Jakobi Heady led Central Michigan (6-9, 0-3) with 19 points. Kyler Vanderjagt added 17 points and Ugnius Jarusevicius scored 11. The Chippewas have lost three games in a row and six of their last seven. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
